summary.text: Brian Echevarria is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 82 who has served since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A financial advisor and local business owner, he represents Cabarrus County.

paragraphs.text: Echevarria was born in Miami, Florida, and his career experience includes working as a financial advisor, local business owner and building contractor.
Echevarria assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2025, succeeding Kristin Baker.
The General Assembly's website lists his occupation as consultant with Walkes and John LLC.

In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the House Select Committee on Property Tax Reduction and Reform and a member of the Finance, Oversight, Regulatory Reform, and Transportation committees, among others.
